rule_en: Ask a question: end a line with a question mark.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house

rule_en: Cry out: end a line with an exclamation mark.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Also what a Riposte house is held to in a verse that opens a round (OPENING_DEVICE); in a solo duel only the opponent opens.

rule_en: Start three words in one line with the same letter.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Three different words of the line, none a stop word, sharing an initial; threshold = shortest word counted.

rule_en: Repeat one strong word three times.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: One word, not a stop word, three times; threshold = shortest word counted.

rule_en: Rhyme two words inside a single line.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Two words inside one line rhyme; threshold = shortest word counted.

rule_en: Turn a word of 5 letters or more from your opponent's last verse back on them.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Cannot land in a verse that opens a round: such a verse is held to The Outcry.

rule_en: Keep every line to 6 words or fewer.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house

rule_en: Make your last line your longest.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Two lines or more; the last strictly the longest.

rule_en: Give every line the same number of words.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Two lines or more, all the same length.

rule_en: End your verse on the same word it began with.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: First unit of the first line equals the last unit of the last line, in a verse of more than two units.

rule_en: Call on a character by name.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Counts the full name of any catalogue character, or its last part when that is not an ordinary word, or the name as the duel language writes it.

rule_en: Use two words of 9 letters or more.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house

rule_en: End every line on the same rhyme.
effect: +0.5 to the craft multiplier when it lands; +0.75 when the deck holds 2+ characters of the house
note: Every line ends on a rhyme of the first line; two lines or more.

rule_en: Their verse may not contain the drawn letter.
effect: -4 craft per breach, at most -12; binds the opponent's next verse

effect: -4 craft per breach, at most -12; binds the opponent's next verse

rule_en: They may not use any word of 4 letters or more twice.
effect: -4 craft per breach, at most -12; binds the opponent's next verse

rule_en: No line of theirs may be longer than 5 words.
effect: -4 craft per breach, at most -12; binds the opponent's next verse

rule_en: Use 2 of the relic's five words.
